metadataReview.note: Reviewed whole-battle dates: 18–20 September 1863. NPS labels 18 September the opening day, 19 September the second day, and describes Wilder’s brigade fighting on all three days. The imported 20 September alone is the concluding day. CDB90 row 200 spans only 19–20 September and remains excluded from automatic whole-battle import; the event is not shortened to fit that source phase.
